messages:
tara-crypto: Heads up team  we're planning an ephemeral-RBAC run for customer BYOK rewraps next week. Need alignment on audit labels, KMS meta fields, and temporary entitlement flow.

ben-sec: What's the exact scope of the ephemeral role? full rsa/import perms or narrow?

tara-crypto: Narrow. Role = `rewrap.operator` with only `kms:Rewrap`, `kms:DescribeKey`, and `kms:SignAttestation`. No Create/Import, no Admin. Grants issued for max 2h via our OIDC broker with justification string.

leo-sre: Operational concerns: rewraps will flood our alert rules (KMS API surge). Can we add a `operation:rewrap-drill` meta field so SIEM can suppress noise but still record raw events? Also need a plan for partial-failure artifacts.

tara-crypto: Yes. We will add `meta.operation=rewrap-drill` and tag keys with `customer:byok,rewrap:2026-04-01`. The rewrap command will include `--meta operation=rewrap-drill --meta run_id=<run-id>`.

olivia-ops: Compliance asks: must produce HSM-signed attestation bundle per customer, plus immutable storage of raw KMS audit. Suggest: HSM signs attestation -> upload to audit bucket under `/byok/<cust-id>/<date>/attestation.json` with object-lock governance/compliance enabled. Also include a manifest listing processed key versions.

ben-sec: Agreed. Also require segregation: account/service that uploads attestations cannot hold `kms:Rewrap` permission. Need two-role flow: `rewrap.operator` (does rewrap) and `attest.uploader` (does upload/sign-index).

leo-sre: I'll create SIEM exceptions for the rewrap window (mute rule ids SIEM-KMS-045 and SIEM-KMS-078) and set a low-severity rate-based watch to catch anomalies. Raw events will still be forwarded to cold-storage for forensic retrieval.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: BYOK Rewrap Run 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-01T05:00:00Z. Ephemeral role TTL=2h per grant. Notify: @oncall, @security.

tara-crypto: Edge cases: 1) mid-batch failures  we produce a `partial_attestation.json` with `processed_count`, `failed_count`, and `last_sequence_id`; 2) absolutely no automated fallback which rewraps to another key without operator consent. We'll add `no_auto_fallback=true` to job manifest.

olivia-ops: For the partial file we should also snapshot the KV cache pointers and sequence offsets so we can replay/verify. Put that in `partial_attestation.detail` and sign it too.

ben-sec: Audit retention: legal requires 7 years for customer crypto events. Ensure bucket lifecycle + object lock compliance mode at prefix `byok/` with 7y retention. Also include key rotation transparency: store `signing_cert_chain.pem` alongside attestation.

leo-sre: I'll add a pipeline that takes attestation -> gzips -> writes to `s3://secure-audit/byok/<cust>/<date>/attestation.json.gz` with SSE-KMS using `arn:aws:kms:...:audit-envelope`. I'll also publish sha256 to the audit index stream.

tara-crypto: Runbook checklist draft (short):
- Create run_id and pre-authorize list of key ARNs
- Request ephemeral grants via OIDC with justification + approver
- Mark keys with `rewrap_in_progress=true` tag
- Run rewrap batch, stream events to `secure-audit` sink
- If any failures, emit partial_attestation and halt
- Generate final attestation signed by HSM `attest-primary` and upload
- Publish SHA256 and push notification to compliance channel

ben-sec: We'll add a post-run review step: security verifies attestation signatures and checks the upload account separation. Also confirm the uploader's identity and presigned S3 ACLs.

infra-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-03-30T18:00:00Z (staging). Tabletop review: 2026-03-31T15:00:00Z (security + ops + oncall).

olivia-ops: FYI  object-lock in Compliance mode requires account-level enablement. I'll send infra ticket to enable object-lock on `secure-audit` and attach lifecycle policy.

leo-sre: One more SRE item: will instrument an attestation verification test that downloads the attestation from S3, verifies HSM signature and cert chain, and validates the SHA256 matches the audit-index entry. Will run during staging dry-run.

tara-crypto: Thanks all. Please review the runbook at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-rewrap-ephemeral-rbac and add comments. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll open the OIDC grant change PR. :thumbsup:

ben-sec: Adding a note: update incident runbooks to include this flow (how to triage an unexpected rewrap outside a window).

olivia-ops: Confirmed  I'll attach lifecycle config and object-lock ticket to the PR.

leo-sre: :rocket:

tara-crypto: Closing loop: prepare checklist items and approvals before we grant ephemeral access.

ben-sec: A final ask  record the approver and reason in the ephemeral token's claim set so auditors can tie a human to each grant.

infra-bot: Event logged: BYOK rewrap run request created by tara-crypto at 1765556789.
